name: AXE AI | Client List Import → Mailbox Check (7 mailboxes) → Emails Beta

parameters.content:
## Client List Import -- compare a client list with Emails Beta, verify new clients in the mailboxes, add them

**One switch: `addToEmailsBeta` (Set Config, currently `true`; set `false` to only preview).** Every run does the same two things:

1. **Checks the next `batchSize` new contacts** (address not in Emails Beta, no "Mailbox check" yet): searches all 7 mailboxes (Outlook: Jack, Mia, Eve, Yolanda. Gmail: Emily, Terry, Office) and writes into the list sheet **Mailbox check** (Found / Not found), **Mailboxes** (where) and **Linked contacts** (other addresses seen on those messages: From/To/Cc). A contact is only marked when every mailbox answered; a failed call leaves it unchecked for the next run.
2. **Plans the groups that are complete.** Checked contacts are grouped **by evidence** (contact B seen on messages found for contact A, directly or through a chain). A group is only complete when every member has been checked. With `addToEmailsBeta = false` the plan is only shown in the summary (`preview`); with `true` every group whose members are ALL checked is appended to Emails Beta in that run (groups with an unchecked member wait for it). If a contact checked later turns out to share messages with a group that was already added, it is flagged "linked to existing client X" in Status and listed in `linkedToExisting` in the summary; it is not merged.

Just run it repeatedly. After saving the check results the workflow re-reads the list and plans again, so groups completed during a run are added in the same run. Run with `false` first and read `preview`, `nameClashes`, `noConversation`, `largeGroups` and `groupsPending` before switching to `true`.

**Rules:** existing clients (address already in an Emails Beta Email cell) are never changed. The list's account Name is NOT used for grouping; it only names the group (first contact's account Name; renamed `Name (address prefix)` if an Emails Beta Name already exists, because the intake workflow finds a client's folder by Name only). A contact linked to an existing client is flagged in Status, not merged. No conversation found in any mailbox: the client is still appended, flagged in Batch (`<label> - no conversation found`) with a blank Platform so the intake workflow skips it. Platform is written as one entry per email (JSON array, e.g. `["outlook",["gmail","outlook"]]`) because the intake workflow assigns platforms to emails by position. Rows with no email are never processed (intake skips them). Matching is by exact address only.

**Mass emails:** messages with more than `maxParticipants` external people still count as a conversation but are not used to link contacts. Our own addresses are ignored as participants (any company mailbox, connected or not, since we can't read the others' conversations): anything on `ownDomains`, listed in `ownAddresses`, or containing a `ownContains` text (default `marblebee`, which covers the company Gmail accounts). An address that shows up on 4+ different contacts is also ignored as a hub (`hubThreshold`) and listed in the summary.

**Safe to re-run:** addresses already in Emails Beta come back as Existing (or `New (<Batch>)`), checked contacts are skipped. The disabled schedule trigger can run it automatically every 15 minutes; turn it off when Status shows no "not checked yet".

**Before the first real run:** the intake workflow picks up rows with Processed = FALSE; keep it off until the Emails Beta import is finished. After import, intake pulls full history for rows with a blank last_synced_at.

**Setup:** list sheet columns `Name`, `Contact email`, `Contact name` are required (found by header name); `Status`, `Matched client`, `Mailbox check`, `Mailboxes` and `Linked contacts` are added to the right automatically if they are missing; Emails Beta `Name`, `Email`, `Processed`, `Platform`, `last_synced_at`, `Batch`. The Google credential's account needs edit access to the list sheet. Select the Outlook credentials on the four `Outlook (...)` nodes after import (Mia, Eve, Yolanda). Two HTTP calls exist on purpose: the header row (column letters) and the bulk Status / check write (one call instead of ~700).
